items.title: Inside Google's Efforts to Get Creatives Hooked on AI
items.excerpt: A look at how Google is courting filmmakers and other creatives to adopt Veo/Flow-era generative tools, from hands-on labs and residencies to studio partnerships. The piece maps the on-ramp Google is building between its models and working production teams.

items.title: AI Studio Asteria Strikes Strategic Partnership With Virtual Production Studio ZeroSpace
items.excerpt: Generative studio Asteria is tying its 'clean' model pipeline to ZeroSpace's virtual production stage, volumetric capture and mocap facilities. The deal points at a hybrid workflow where live capture and generative shots are built in the same production.

items.title: Oscar-Qualifying Bengaluru International Short Film Festival Expands to 10 Arenas, Adds AI and Dance Competitions
items.excerpt: The Oscar-qualifying Bengaluru shorts festival adds a 'Machine Made Movies' section open to films made wholly or partly with AI tools, running Aug. 14-16 with an online window Aug. 6-16. An Oscar-qualifying festival formally opening a generative category is a notable legitimacy marker.

items.title: Promise AI Developing Horror Feature 'Touch Grass'; Dave Clark Directing
items.excerpt: AI studio Promise is developing an original horror feature with 'Backrooms' filmmaker Dave Clark directing, produced with Bloody Disgusting. It is another test of whether a generative-first pipeline can carry a full narrative feature rather than a short.

items.title: Gregg Araki Found AI Useful for Editing This 'I Want Your Sex' Scene
items.excerpt: Araki, who says he is no AI supporter, describes using AI in post to salvage a specific scene in 'I Want Your Sex.' A concrete case of an auteur drawing the line at invisible repair work rather than generation.

items.title: Locarno Gets Down to Business With Talk on AI, Algorithms, Investment
items.excerpt: Locarno's StepIn think tank put AI and algorithmic curation at the centre of its industry session, covering how discovery systems and generative tools reshape what gets financed. Festival-level policy signal on where European producers are drawing lines.

items.title: HBO Max Dips Toe Into Vertical Video With 'HBO Max Shorts' and New AI-Driven Features
items.excerpt: HBO Max is launching a vertical 'Shorts' feed alongside AI-driven conversational search and discovery features. A streamer reformatting premium catalogue for vertical playback changes the framing and cutdown work asked of editors and promo teams.

items.title: 'Asphalt Guerrilla' Blends Fact, Fiction, AI and a Story About Filmmaking
items.excerpt: The Locarno 2026 title mixes documentary material, fiction and AI-generated imagery into a film about filmmaking itself. An example of generative footage used as an authored formal device rather than a cost-saving shortcut.

items.title: Bob Gaudette and Kirk Hipkiss Launch AI Film and TV Production Studio Nolia
items.excerpt: The Toronto studio is built around original IP, with 'The Little Cloud Thief' in development as both a feature and an episodic series. Gaudette's eight-minute short took the $50K Grand Prix at this year's Runway AI Festival.

items.title: ILM and Pixar Named in Disney's AI Push as Cost Cuts Continue
items.excerpt: An SEC filing shows Disney funding machine learning at Disney Research Studios and Imagineering, with ILM and Pixar named, and promising a creative process that stays 'human-centered.' The pledge lands after job reductions at Pixar and the creation of an internal AI oversight body.

items.title: Who Thought Using a Podcast Hosted by AI Dogs to Promote 'The End of Oak Street' Was a Good Idea?
items.excerpt: Warner Bros. promoted its new release with a podcast fronted by AI-generated talking dogs, and the campaign drew immediate backlash. A live case study in how generative assets land in film marketing and key-art/trailer adjacent craft.

items.title: Creating an AI Short Film (Full Workflow) | Runway
items.excerpt: Runway walks through an end-to-end short-film build inside its toolset, from reference and shot planning to generation, extension and assembly. A rare start-to-finish look at how a generative short is actually structured rather than a feature teaser.

items.title: This AI film is a Masterpiece
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge breaks down an AI-generated short it rates as a craft high-water mark, examining the shot design, continuity and edit decisions behind it. Useful as a read on where generative filmmaking quality actually sits right now.

items.title: NVIDIA's World Model is the Future
items.excerpt: A filmmaker-facing test of NVIDIA's world model, arguing persistent 3D-consistent scene generation beats prompt-to-clip for shot continuity. Frames world models as the next controllability step after text-to-video.
